name: Tactical Experience (Combat)
body:
You have spent enough time on the battlefield to gain insight into basic tactics.

Prerequisite(s): Any two combat feats

Benefit(s): Whenever you use a combat feat that requires you to take a penalty to an attack or damage roll, you reduce that penalty by 1. This feat counts as Combat Expertise and Intelligence 13 for the purpose of meeting prerequisites.
